title: Add comprehensive ecosystem development roadmap and status tracking
body:
Analyzed 15 packages across 139 Zod schemas to document the complete ObjectStack ecosystem state and create actionable development plans through Q4 2026.

## Deliverables (2,513 lines)

### Strategic Documentation

- **DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md** (1,326 lines)
  - Technical roadmap for 8 product pillars (ObjectQL, ObjectUI, ObjectOS, ObjectAI, Cloud, Marketplace, Studio, Automation)
  - Quarterly milestones with sprint-level breakdowns
  - Technical specifications with code examples
  - Business model: $1.5M ARR target through cloud, marketplace, enterprise

- **EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md** (468 lines)
  - "Eight Pillars" framework with completion metrics (47% overall)
  - Critical gaps blocking production (aggregations, permissions, PostgreSQL driver, workflows, AI runtime, cloud infrastructure)
  - Success metrics and adoption targets

### Implementation Tracking

- **IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md** (421 lines)
  - Package-by-package completion percentages
  - Protocol coverage across 11 domains (Data: 65%, UI: 35%, System: 45%, AI: 10%)
  - Feature-level status (e.g., ObjectQL: CRUD ✅, Aggregations 20%, Joins 10%, Transactions 0%)
  - Weekly sprint planning

- **PRODUCT_MATRIX_CN.md** (298 lines, Chinese)
  - Product matrix with quarterly timeline
  - Priority classification (P0: critical path, P1: important, P2: enhancement)

### Navigation

- Updated **README.md** with "Planning & Roadmap" section linking to all strategic documents

## Current State Summary

| Layer | Schemas | Implementation | Critical Gaps |
|-------|---------|----------------|---------------|
| Core | N/A | 90% | None |
| ObjectQL | 20 | 60% | Aggregations, joins, PostgreSQL driver |
| ObjectUI | 10 | 40% | Form/dashboard/page builders |
| ObjectOS | 23 | 30% | Permissions, workflows, multi-tenancy |
| ObjectAI | 13 | 10% | Runtime, RAG, agents (schemas only) |
| Cloud | - | 0% | Everything (not started) |

## Quarterly Targets

- **Q1 2026**: Aggregations, permissions, form builder, model registry, triggers → 80% core
- **Q2 2026**: SQL drivers, Cloud beta, marketplace, dashboards, workflows → Production-ready
- **Q3 2026**: AI agents, NoSQL drivers, page builder, multi-tenancy → AI-native
- **Q4 2026**: PWA, NLQ, edge deployment, monetization → Enterprise scale
